purpose: Selected example policy, not mandatory physical layers. Approve repository defaults once; revise on architectural changes.
tests: tests/order* and tests/test_order* are orders-owned; billing equivalents are billing-owned. Owner tests may import internals. Consumer tests use only public API.

coverage.typescript: Type checking and behavioral tests; dependency-cruiser boundary/cycle checks; ESLint config currently has no substantive lint rules
coverage.python: Ruff, Pyright, Import Linter selected contracts, pytest; no comprehensive internal cycle detection

limitations: State ownership requires review. Green entrypoint proves only listed coverage. Baseline failures must be compared explicitly; never blanket-skipped.
direction: One orders owner; api and persistence depend on domain. This layout is illustrative, not required.
typing: TypeScript strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, and exactOptionalPropertyTypes; Python explicit optional lookup results.
errors: Missing orders are ordinary outcomes: TypeScript QuoteResult discriminates quoted (Quote payload) from not-found; Python quote_order returns Quote | None. Invalid ids raise validation errors; repository/operational failures propagate unchanged.
